BiblicalUsage: Moda is a kinsman, an acquaintance — Boaz is a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech, and wisdom says, call understanding thy kinswoman.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the kinsman is the Bible's picture of the redeemer: near enough to help, and willing to pay.
